note: The human woke the Queen by hand at 11:57Z after about 16 idle hours, then changed the experiment mid-run (specimen commit b48de87). GOAL.md: the interface must be in Brazilian Portuguese (new requirement and new Definition of Done item). Queen prompt: Issues labelled `request` are suggestions from the human that she accepts, folds in or declines. Infrastructure: runs_per_day 6 to 10 per role; heartbeat cron from three times a day to every 3 hours, ended for free by the guard when a Worker is busy and nothing awaits review; weekly budget US$54 to US$85 conservative and 45M to 70M raw tokens. The repository description, homepage and topics were set by the human, since the Queen App has no administration permission.
